buyer_added_terms.text: Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility Criteria: 1.1. The bidder/ manufacturer must have supplied at least 10 nos. same/ higher capacity of Ride on sweep er in last Three years (to be reckoned from the original date of closing of tender). 1.2. Statement of past supplies along with, (i) purchaser’s name and (ii) address, (iii) email address and (iv ) phone/fax number of purchaser, (v) purchase order (PO) or supply order number and (vi) PO date (vii) alo ng with the copies of purchase order (PO), (viii) quantity supplied (with proof of supply), (ix) date of supply and (x) their commissioning date shall be submitted with the offer. 1.3. The tenderer shall, in their offer, submit performance certificate of 05 nos. of such Ride on Sweeper, s upplied in the last three years and the machine covered by these certificates must have worked satisfactor ily for at least one year from the date of commissioning as on the original date of closing of tender 1.4. Documentary evidence i.e., Copies Purchase orders, Supply, Installation and successful Commissionin g reports issued by the above organizations must be furnished along with their offer evidencing the execut ion of such purchase orders. The offers without the documentary evidence shall be rejected summarily. 1.5. Tenderers are advised to furnish clause wise comments for the technical specifications (GeM Specifica tion) in their offer. If any deviation w.r.t the technical specifications, the same to be clearly specified in the offer and submit the justification for the deviations. 1.6. Tenderers should offer and quote for all the specified concomitant accessories, as these are considere d essential for commissioning and utilization of the machine. Even if bidder does not recommend the purch ase of any of these accessories, the price must be quoted for comparison purposes and their recommenda tion/suggestion to be indicated in the offer. Tenderers should also quote for optional accessories, spares a nd consumable spares as asked in the specifications 1.7. In case, any item is required in sets, please specify nos. /pieces per set. This is essential for proper tec hnical evaluation of the offer. Offers received without this may be considered as incomplete and liable to b e rejected. 1.8. The bidder has adequate plant and manufacturing capacity and has a ‘Quality Assurance Programme”. The manufacturer shall have valid ISO 9001 certificate on the date of closing of Tender and a copy of same shall be submitted along with the bid. The Ride on sweeper shall be in the scope of ISO certificate. Non-compliance of above (about past performance) shall lead to summarily rejection of the offer and no co rrespondence in this regard will be entertained. 2. TECHNICAL LITERATURE 2.1. One copy of the printed illustrative catalogue showing features of the machine and its elements must be enclosed with each copy of the bid. 2.2. The successful tenderer will have to furnish, for each machine 01 set of the technical literatures of co mplete machine including imported and indigenously purchased components/sub-assemblies to the consig nee directly within 3 months of placement of P.O. Out of these, the tenderer shall be required to submit on e set of all documents in best available condition one month prior to training cum Inspection of the machin e. Tenderers should provide a list of literature, which they will supply along with the machine. One set of technical literature should cover the following details: 2.2.1. Operational & Maintenance manual of the ride on sweeper. 2.2.2. Wiring diagram, in which length of electrical wires must be mentioned, hard copies in A-3 size as wel l as soft copy in PDF format. 2.2.3. Spare part manual including part lists no., hard copies in A-4 size as well as in PDF format. 2.2.4. Lay out drawings in A-1 size, which clearly shows the position of all type of electrical components in

machine. 2.2.5. Diagnostic & Trouble shooting Guide for Microprocessor based Control System 3. WARRANTY OBLIGATION 3.1. The machine shall be designed for a life of 10 years with regular maintenance and all the structural m embers of the machine and the foundation shall be guaranteed for 10 years against cracks breakages and etc. during the course of normal operations. Tenderer would submit suitable undertaking. 3.2. The equipment should be offered with comprehensive warranty of Minimum 24 months from the date of commissioning. 4. Spares to be supplied as per the attached spares document. 5. Delivery of the material & documents if any, to be sent to the Consignee only. a]. Consignee details: Senior Section Engineer/ Carriage&Wagon/GOOTY (SSE/C&W/GY ),Anantapur(dist),A NDHRA PRADESH. Mobile:9701342010 For payment details firm should contact the consignee only and not to buyer/Purchaser. b] Bill passing officer: Senior Divisional Mechanical Engineer/Carriage &Wagon /Guntakal (Sr.DME/C&W/GT L).Mobile :9701374400 c] Bill paying officer: Accounts Department (9701374100/9701374103) . 3.
